hypothesis: Reducing the six-ply continuation history weight in quiet move ordering may improve cutoff selection and playing strength.
change: In MovePicker::generate_and_score<QUIETS>(), add (*ch5)[pc][to] / 2 instead of the full term. Keep the history update and other terms fixed.

bench.primary_observation: Reproducible node signatures for each revision. Two repetitions under shared cloud conditions cannot establish a speed effect.

screen.decision_rule: Use the lab's fixed-sample paired Hoeffding 95% interval. Interpret an interval spanning zero and +3 as inconclusive. Play exactly the planned pairs once after correctness and review.
screen.budget: One bounded local diagnostic screen. No public runs or promotion.
